excludedCategories.A04:2025: No cryptography, secrets or TLS handling is introduced in this cycle; the pre-existing plaintext passwords are unchanged and out of scope
excludedCategories.A07:2025: No authentication or session code is changed in this cycle; the pre-existing email-token model is out of scope (Q3 A) and its use by new endpoints is scored under SEC-01
excludedCategories.A08:2025: No deserialization of untrusted objects, signed updates or CI/CD (CI opted out)

evalCriteria.prompt: Review every endpoint added or changed in the diff that reads or mutates a user's plan or billing data. Score 0 if a changed endpoint acts on the account named by a client-supplied email (query or body) without the server verifying that the caller is authenticated as that account. Cite the file and line.

Check the upgrade flow in the diff. Score 0 if the server accepts a plan, price, feature set or charge amount from the client, if the preview endpoint writes state, or if a repeated upgrade of an already-Premium account is not rejected server-side. Cite the file and line.

Check every error path added or changed in the diff (backend handlers and frontend fetch calls). Score 0 if a response can include a stack trace, exception text or internal state, if an unexpected backend exception is not converted to a generic 500, or if a frontend request failure is left unhandled (unhandled promise rejection) or leaves the page in a half-updated state. Cite the file and line.

Check logging added or changed in the diff. Score 0 if an upgrade attempt or its outcome is not logged server-side, or if any changed log statement records a password or an entire user record containing the password. Cite the file and line.

Check every place in the diff where request input (email, query parameters) or API data reaches the DOM or a string that is interpreted. Score 0 if request input is used without Pydantic/type validation on a new endpoint, or if any changed frontend code renders API or user text with dangerouslySetInnerHTML or equivalent raw HTML insertion. Cite the file and line.

Check dependency manifests changed in the diff. Score 0 if a new dependency is added unpinned or with a floating range in a Python requirements file, if a runtime (non-dev) dependency is added, or if a package with a known critical or high vulnerability is introduced. Cite the file and line.

Check configuration changed in the diff. Score 0 if the diff widens CORS, enables a debug mode, or adds an endpoint that bypasses the existing FastAPI app and middleware. Pre-existing wildcard CORS that the diff does not touch is not scored. Cite the file and line.
